methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: NoVA Leaders Debate Data Centers, Metro Funding And Affordable Housing - Patch
signals.signal_reading: NoVA leaders debating data center policy signals deepening technical governance capacity concentrated in the state's wealthiest region, while rural areas lack both the infrastructure and policy expertise to participate in AI-driven economic development decisions.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - axios.com
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce suggests platform-delivered tools creating broad but shallow adoption—workers must adapt to AI systems rather than developing deep technical capability to build or customize them.

signals.title: Virginia Beach schools bring ChatGPT under division oversight as AI use grows - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach schools bringing ChatGPT under division oversight indicates distributed access to AI platforms, but institutional control over consumption rather than creation signals shallow adoption spreading geographically without building indigenous capability.

signals.title: Norfolk could get AI assist for non-emergency calls - yahoo.com
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk deploying AI for non-emergency calls demonstrates distributed geographic adoption of turnkey AI solutions, but reliance on vendor-provided platforms rather than local development capacity signals shallow implementation spreading beyond NoVA.

signals.title: Virginia Tech gears up to fight enemy drones
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's $5M Army drone project in Southwest Virginia creates a rare non-metro node of deep technical capability, potentially catalyzing peer-to-peer knowledge networks that could distribute AI fluency beyond traditional urban centers if sustained.
